title: XTEND AI Robotics gets $40.5M order for 6,000 drones
source_used: headlines of The Business Journals, Business Wire, Investing.com, StreetInsider, Dealroom (pages blocked)
key_facts: Headline of the Business Wire release: XTEND Awarded $40.5 Million Order for 6,000 STRIKER Systems Following Drone Dominance Program Gauntlet II.
Investing.com headline: XTEND secures $40.5M order for 6,000 drone systems from DoD.
Dealroom headline refers to the order coming months after a $1 billion merger.
why_it_matters_hint: A large US defence drone order for a company formed by merger.
notes: Pages for The Business Journals, Business Wire, Investing.com and StreetInsider were blocked; facts here are only from the headlines the outlets published. The buyer is named as DoD only in the Investing.com headline.
